ice.text: Jodah, the archmage who ruled the School of the Unseen, was sold out by Gerda and Gustha, who gave him to Lim-Dûl in exchange for the Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn and a mirror.
Lim-Dûl muddled his memory, but Jaya Ballard rescued him, discovered that Gustha and Gerda had betrayed him, and cured him with his own mirror.
Together they helped foil a coup against King Darien and, in the last battle, Jodah faced Lim-Dûl until Leshrac tore the necromancer apart.
Jodah then vented the World Spell through the safe havens to end the Ice Age, and later Freyalise offered to make him a planeswalker, but he had no spark.

all.text: In Alliances, Gerda and Gustha kidnapped Jodah and gave him to Lim-Dûl, who imprisoned him in Tresserhorn and clouded his mind with Fyndhorn Pollen.
Jaya Ballard rescued him and called on Freyalise to cure him, which put them in the planeswalker's debt, and the two then warned Kjeld, where the Knights of Stromgald's coup failed.
Later, at Soldev, Jaya, possessed by Mairsil and Lim-Dûl through a ring, stabbed Jodah, and his blood woke the War Beasts that leveled the School of the Unseen.
Jodah smashed his mirror in Jaya's face, burning away the two minds and igniting her spark, and he chose not to rebuild the school and hid behind legends.

dmu.text: Jodah presided over a peace summit between the Keldons and New Benalia, until Karn and Teferi revealed that the Phyrexians had returned.
When Benalish knights burst into Phyrexian monsters, Jodah opened a portal to New Argive's watchtower so the group could escape, and inside it he and Jaya fought a squid-like Phyrexian.
He then travelled to Yavimaya to ask the elves for support, and with Meria defeated a Phyrexian dragon engine using a Thran artifact.

Jodah fought at the Mana Rig as a leader of the New Coalition and delivered Jaya's eulogy, and he gave Urza's time machine blueprints to Teferi, Saheeli and Kaya before being grievously wounded defending the tower from Rona's forces.
